migration_issues.title: Neurosim: extract canvas, project, and CNL-sync contracts from the spec
migration_issues.objective: Convert canvas nodes, edges, projects, sweep configs, and CNL synchronization payloads into explicit contracts.
conversion_steps: Create contract models for node types, connections, parameter panels, project files, and sync payloads.
Validate connection weights, delays, and allowed layer references before backend simulation calls.
Make .neurosim project files parse through a single shared contract layer.
acceptance_checks: Canvas JSON round-trips through contracts without topology loss.
Invalid connection payloads fail fast with clear reasons.
CNL sync payloads cannot omit required network metadata.

migration_issues.title: Neurosim: add property tests for topology and simulation invariants
migration_issues.objective: Encode the visual editor and simulation invariants so invalid graphs and impossible parameter states cannot pass CI.
conversion_steps: Add properties for parameter bounds, sweep ranges, and graph consistency.
Add properties for canvas-to-CNL and CNL-to-canvas round trips.
Add export properties ensuring the canonical CNL export stays stable across conversions.
acceptance_checks: Parameter sweeps reject invalid ranges and step counts.
Graph round trips preserve directed-edge semantics.
Export paths cannot silently drop project metadata.

migration_issues.title: Neurosim: add missing Jules workflows and full contract CI
migration_issues.objective: Bring Neurosim up to the same operational baseline as the other modules so migration issues can be picked up, fixed, and merged automatically.
conversion_steps: Extend ci.yml with lint, mypy, unit tests, and property tests.
Add feature-builder.yml, bug-fixer.yml, ci-failure-fix.yml, unblocked-issues.yml, and auto-merge-jules-prs.yml.
Use the shared templates so failure repair and auto-merge behave consistently with the other modules.
acceptance_checks: Neurosim has the same core issue-driven automation surface as the mature modules.
CI failures can trigger a Jules repair attempt.
Agent PRs can auto-merge after all checks pass.
workflow_updates: Create the missing workflows using the patterns already used by Neurobench and the shared templates in this folder.
Invoke the shared CDD-PBT workflow from Neurosim CI.
